description: The Office of Congresswoman Linda Sánchez is seeking to immediately fill a full-time job opening for a Scheduler based in her District Office. Salary will depend on the experience of the applicant. Employees will receive health care insurance, 401(k)-style retirement benefits, and other federal employee benefits.

description: Staff Assistant position in the District Office. Duties include answering phones, handling mail and faxes, greeting and directing visitors, maintaining order and efficiency of front and back offices, ordering supplies, organizing office files, coordinating with the Capitol Office to arrange tour and flag requests, coordinating vendor service needs, researching the status of some legislation, drafting some correspondence, and assisting the District Director and all District Office staff with additional tasks as needed. In the absence of the District Scheduler, the staff assistant serves as backup and helps facilitate scheduling requests. Casework duties include assisting constituents with individual cases pertaining to federal agencies, helping constituents obtain timely consideration and cut through red tape, and as the front-line caseworker, helping constituents with nonfederal questions find appropriate resources.

description: Southern conservative Republican seeks a Staff Assistant to handle a wide range of office responsibilities and constituent services in the Washington office. Primary responsibilities for this position include (1) answering the main telephone line for the office, (2) processing flag requests, (3) arranging tours of the Capitol, (4) preparing the office for daily activities, and (5) drafting personal notes and letters of commendation to constituents. Other responsibilities may be assigned. Because the Member places a special emphasis on constituent services, candidates must be able to maintain a courteous and respectful demeanor at all times and possess a true desire to help constituents. Competitive candidates will be confident and well-spoken, have excellent oral and written communication skills, possess an acute attention to detail, demonstrate an assertive and organized approach to problem solving, and exhibit an ability to multi-task in a fast paced work environment. Though duties are largely administrative in nature, the Staff Assistant should have a personal interest in current events and Congressional activities, and should be fully engaged in all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the office. Additionally, the daily work hours for this position are 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Completion of a four-year college education is required. Prior work experience is preferred. Southern ties are a significant plus. Interested individuals should send a resume, cover letter, and two writing samples to congressjob@gmail.com.
